title: UGC Style Product Photos for Ads and Listings | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into UGC style product photos: a review, unboxing, or demo still for ads and listings. Write the caption after you download.
h1: UGC Style Product Photos for Ads and Listings
lead: Booking a creator for every product slows the next post. Upload one product photo and get UGC style product photos for the feed.
steps_h2: Make User-Generated Content Style Images in 3 Steps
steps_lead: Upload the product, pick a creator-style scene, then download a still for the feed.

steps.d: Upload one product photo with the package or product complete and easy to see. That file is the source for every scene you generate.
Pick a routine, unboxing or demo style. Add one line about the setting if you want, then generate.
Download the photo and add the caption or offer in your own editor. Keep prices and claims as text you can edit later.

faq.q: What is a UGC style product photo?
faq.a: Upload one product photo and get a creator-style review, unboxing or demo still, without filming a creator. The person in the frame is generated.

faq.q: Do I have to describe the whole scene?
faq.a: No. Upload the product photo and pick a routine, unboxing or demo. One short line about the room or the light is optional.
Ecommerce sellers, marketers and agencies that need social photos for ads, carousels and product pages without booking a shoot.

faq.q: Where do the square photos fit?
faq.a: They fit Instagram and TikTok posts, carousels and product galleries. For a full-screen Story, place the square on a tall canvas in your editor.
Yes. Upload one product photo, choose a style and download the result. You do not need editing experience.

faq.q: Can I make several scenes from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same photo for a routine, an unboxing or a demo. Each scene is its own job, and the cost is shown before it starts.

faq.q: What does a creator-style photo cost, and can it run as an ad?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits, the cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns those credits. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in your own ads, pages and posts. You are still responsible for the claims and disclosures in the ad.

faq.q: When should I make a video instead?
faq.a: Choose video when the ad needs motion, a voice or a sequence. That path starts at [AI UGC video ads](page:video-ads). This template stops at a still.

steps.prompt: The bottle sits in a quiet corner after a workout, with a light curl of condensation and the whole bottle easy to see.
